verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly confirm multi-language transcription and summary support (31 languages desktop, 17 mobile), directly addressing the founder's need. However, there is no evidence on handling mid-meeting language switching or accuracy/quality across non-English languages, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of multilingual performance. missing for 10: evidence of language-switching-within-a-meeting handling, independent user reports on non-English transcription accuracy, and details on which specific languages/dialects are supported.
